purpose: Collect paired 50Hz whole-body trajectories and read-only 500Hz receiver contact snapshots for support-leg/swing-leg sequence learning. No actor is trained or promoted by this course.
data_gate: All 24 protocol/report/trace hashes must verify; the parent-s02 row must reproduce the prior frame-66/83 event; >=20 rows must have complete identity-bound dynamic receiver contact capture, >=4 must have safe clean dynamic second-foot positives, and >=8 must have verified negatives. Otherwise no supervised sequence actor training is authorized.
split: All 24 are consumed development data; no Fresh or promotion. Freeze future holdout scenes separately only after actor, loss, and safety gates are fixed.
next_if_sparse: If positives are too sparse, learn contact dynamics and generate physically valid positive exemplars with broader support-leg/step controller exploration; do not label near misses as success.
